import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Set style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
scatter = sns.scatterplot(
    data=data,
    x='model_year',
    y='price_usd',
    hue='sensor_type',
    style='has_video_4k',
    size='megapixels',
    sizes=(20, 200),
    markers=True,
    legend='full'
)

# Add labels
for line in range(0, data.shape[0]):
    scatter.text(data.model_year[line], data.price_usd[line], data.brand[line], 
                 horizontalalignment='center', size='small', color='black')

plt.title('Camera Price vs Model Year with Sensor Type and Megapixels')
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type / 4K Video', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()
